title: Kinetic modeling of methanol synthesis from renewable resources

model_assumptions.text: Catalyst deactivation neglected; only reactions (1)-(3) considered.
model_assumptions.quote: The catalyst deactivation is neglected and no side reactions beyond Eqs. (1)–(3) are considered.

model_assumptions.text: Total numbers of oxidized, reduced and hydrogen centers are constant.
model_assumptions.quote: In a first step, constant total numbers of oxidized, reduced as well as hydrogen centers are assumed.
The other steps are assumed to be much faster such that equilibrium can be assumed for them.
